Important Information Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow 2. Keep the area dry 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product) 4. Frequently asked questions About Face and Body Acne Kit for Women When's the best time to use this kit? Use the facewash in your AM/PM routine — start once a day and build up to twice daily as your skin adjusts. The bodywash can be used once a day, every day, in your regular shower routine. How does Benzoyl Peroxide help with acne? Benzoyl Peroxide kills acne-causing bacteria and germs on the surface of your skin while controlling excess oil. It's best suited for severe, persistent acne on the face and body, in both teenagers and adults. How long until I see visible results? Facewash: visible results typically show in about 8 weeks of consistent use. Bodywash: with daily use, most people see a difference in back and body acne within a similar timeframe. For full results across both, consistent use for 3-4 months is recommended. Will this kit remove my acne marks and spots, or just active acne? Both products are formulated to calm inflamed, active acne and prevent new breakouts from forming. For acne marks or pigmentation left behind, we'd suggest following up with a targeted product like a 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum. What should I use after this kit as part of my routine? For the face, follow up with a gel-based moisturiser and sunscreen. This helps keep skin hydrated and protected while the Benzoyl Peroxide works.
